title: Synthesis of N-Heterocycles using [3+2] Cycloaddition Reactions
summary: Our lab is interested in the creation of new methods for synthesizing N-heterocycles using cycloadditions starting from tertiary amine N-oxides.
description:
Our lab is interested in the creation of new methods for synthesizing N-heterocycles using cycloadditions starting from tertiary amine N-oxides.

We develop new reaction pathways and study selectivity and scope. We also connect experimental results with mechanistic models where possible.

title: Using Computational Methods to Probe Chemical Mechanisms
summary: How reactions occur can offer significant insight into the capabilities and limitations of a given chemical method. We make use of a combination of experimental observations and density functional theory computations to elucidate chemical mechanisms.

title: Generation of Photophysical Materials
summary: Aza-dipyrromethenes (aza-DIPYs) are a class of chemical dyes that display strong absorption and emission profiles in the visible and near-IR region of the electromagnetic spectrum.
description:
Aza-dipyrromethenes (aza-DIPYs) are a class of chemical dyes that display strong absorption and emission profiles in the visible and near-IR region of the electromagnetic spectrum.

We design, synthesize, and characterize these dyes for improved stability and tunable optical properties.
